title: 2019 Travis Homer Panini Absolute Rookie Card # 187 RB Seattle Seahawks Football
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2019 Panini Absolute Travis Homer Rookie Card #187 featuring the player as a running back for the Seattle Seahawks in the National Football League (NFL). The card is an original licensed reprint and does not come with an autograph. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini and part of the 2019 season set.
